items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Basie had a fantastic rhythm section back in those days when he had him and had Walter Page and the metronome, Freddie Green.

ctx.x: On this high hat cymbal and the sock cymbal. He was truly a master.
Yeah. Basie had a fantastic rhythm section back in those days when he had him and had Walter Page and the metronome, Freddie Green.
Freddie Green. That's supposed to be the all-American rhythm section.
